brief: An independent, open-source native Mac translator. A clear P holds a T in its negative space, identifying PlainTranslate with one compact silhouette.
criteria: Recognisable at 16px; works as a one-colour menu icon, in the Dock and on GitHub. No shared cloud key or affiliation with Vorssaint.

concepts.name: P / T — Meaning in the space
concepts.idea: The P names the app; the transparent T is discovered inside it.
rationale: One stable silhouette for small native surfaces.
Black and white remain legible without shading.
Original outlined lettering requires no font files.

recommendation: Approved direction A. Use the black tile in the Dock, the black template in the menu bar and the horizontal lockup for the repository.
next_steps: Use the supplied assets without redrawing the wordmark.
Keep the transparent T open at small sizes.
Print and trademark checks remain separate from digital artwork verification.
